bagPolicy.summary: The O2 Arena in Prague prohibits bringing excess luggage larger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm. Certain items like laptops and tablets are allowed only for VIP guests.
prohibited: food and beverages (except for health reasons)
spray paints or deodorants – over 100 ml
excess luggage (bigger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm)
unworn clothing (excluding items purchased from official merchandising)
laptops and tablets (except for VIP guests)
umbrellas (except in the case of rain)
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for health reasons are allowed for food and beverages.

parking.note: Parking is available at the dedicated parking garage accessible via Českomoravská Street and Lisabonská Street. Alternative parking options include the nearby STAGES HOTEL Prague and Galerie Harfa shopping center.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in O2 Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The O2 Arena offers a variety of food options, including fast food refreshments and exclusive catering for VIP areas. The Lokomotivka restaurant provides a unique dining experience with a bar accessible during certain events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by O2 Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in O2 Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at O2 Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at O2 Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
